summary: Iter87 — Inner Realm rename + size + widget persistence QA. Backend 16/17 pytest cases PASS (1 SKIP for widget registry alt endpoints). Widget PERSISTENCE across backend restart works PERFECTLY: PATCH widgets=[top8] then supervisor restart backend + GET /auth/me still exactly [top8]; PATCH widgets=[] persists as empty across restart; fresh-registered account still gets default [myfeed,top8] with title 'Inner Realm'; PATCH bio does NOT clobber widgets. inner_realm_size validation PASS: 4/8/12/24 all accept + persist; 7 → 400 with exact msg 'Inner Realm size must be 4, 8, 12 or 24'; non-friend uuid → 400; storage cap 24; lowering size preserves inner_8 order. HOWEVER two CRITICAL frontend defects + one backend data-migration miss violate the review spec: (A) Top8Editor.jsx L125 hard-codes 'Top 8 auto-saves' heading — NOT 'Inner Realm' — visible on /profile edit and view for every user with a top8 widget; L215 picker modal title 'Add to Top 8'; L131 grid-cols hard-coded 4/8 (not size-aware for 12/24); (B) Top8Editor.jsx ships NO Size selector UI — `changeSize` is defined but never rendered, `data-testid=inner-realm-size-select` is completely absent from DOM; hidden-note is also missing (`data-testid=inner-realm-hidden-note`); (C) migrate_rename_top8_titles only touches db.progression_tasks — the actual live tasks come from progression_level_versions[i].snapshot.tasks[] which still contain name='Complete your Top 8', description='Add users to Top 8', button_label='Edit Top 8' on Rising Star level_id 34e8263eb3484e458b696691b1817940 (v2). Home /home shows 3 collapsible sections (Fire Power / Rising Star Progress / Progression Badges) all collapsed on load, mobile scrollWidth==390 no overflow — PASS. Public visitor and logged-out flow deferred to main-agent-verified behaviour.

critical.issue: Only renames db.progression_tasks; the user-facing tasks that /api/progression/me returns are stored inside progression_level_versions[i].snapshot.tasks[] and still say 'Complete your Top 8' / 'Add users to Top 8' / button_label='Edit Top 8'. Confirmed via progression_level_versions doc level_id=34e8263eb3484e458b696691b1817940 v=2 (Rising Star, level 4). Any user on this level (e.g. stealth, auditcheckreal) sees the old label.

ui_bugs.issue: Line 125 hardcodes 'Top 8' as the editor heading (`<Sparkles size={16} /> Top 8 auto-saves`). Should read 'Inner Realm'. Violates review requirement '/profile Edit Profile editor heading (Top8Editor)'.
Line 215 picker modal title 'Add to Top 8' should read 'Add to Inner Realm'.

Inner Realm Size selector UI is completely missing. The review spec mandates `data-testid="inner-realm-size-select"` with options '4 Members' / '8 Members' / '12 Members' / '24 Members'. The `changeSize` handler is defined (L56) and `size` is read from `user.inner_realm_size` (L53) — but no <select> is ever rendered.

Hidden-note UI is missing (`data-testid="inner-realm-hidden-note"`). `hiddenCount` is computed on L55 but never rendered. Users who lower the display size will not see any indication that members are hidden.

Grid on L131 hardcodes `grid-cols-4 sm:grid-cols-8` — not size-aware. When size=12 or size=24 the grid still wraps at 8 columns per row on desktop; not aligned to the sizes 4/8/12/24 required by spec.

The widget header on /profile currently reads 'Top 8 auto-saves' because Top8Editor is rendered in-place instead of TopEightWidget. Even though the DB row's `w.title` is 'Inner Realm', the editor's hardcoded heading takes precedence.

action_items: Top8Editor.jsx L125: replace `Top 8` heading text with `Inner Realm`.
Top8Editor.jsx L215: replace `Add to Top 8` picker title with `Add to Inner Realm`.
Top8Editor.jsx: render an actual <select data-testid="inner-realm-size-select"> that calls the existing `changeSize` handler with 4/8/12/24 as options; wire label to say 'Members'.
Top8Editor.jsx: render an `<div data-testid="inner-realm-hidden-note">` when `hiddenCount > 0` (message like `${hiddenCount} member(s) hidden — raise the size to see them again`).
Top8Editor.jsx L131: make the grid columns size-aware. Suggestion: `grid-cols-4` for size 4, `sm:grid-cols-8` for size 8, `sm:grid-cols-6` for 12, `sm:grid-cols-8` for 24 with row-wrap.

Same rewrite for any admin-facing progression_tasks docs that reference top8.

Verify /home logged-out gating on a hard-refresh — my automation cleared localStorage but the SPA still rendered the widget cluster (may be a testing artifact from cached auth token; main agent already verified this passes in a clean session).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend widget persistence architecture is correct: migrate_inject_myfeed_widget & migrate_inject_top8_widget now guard on `profile_widgets_customized` and skip the founder — verified across two live supervisor restarts within the test run.

routers/profile.py update_profile flips `profile_widgets_customized=True` inside the same $set doc as the widgets — atomic; no window where a mid-restart could see customized=false with a saved layout.
inner_realm_size validation is tight: exactly one Python `in (4,8,12,24)` check + a stable error string — clients can match on it.
inner_8 friend-only guard (L64) correctly iterates and 400s on the first non-friend id — good; consider adding the failing id to the error detail for debuggability.

migrate_rename_top8_titles is inherently incomplete: level-config live data lives in `progression_level_versions.snapshot.tasks` (Level Builder snapshots each publish) — a title-only rename that ignores this collection cannot cover all user-facing task labels. See DB dump above.

Top8Editor.jsx is a partial implementation of the Inner Realm spec: has the friend picker, add/remove/reorder, correct save-side inner_8 PATCH & size-aware `slots`; but the size <select>, hidden-note, and Inner-Realm rename in the heading + picker title were not shipped. `changeSize` is dead code today.

rca of the issue: Root cause A (editor heading & picker title): Top8Editor.jsx was created for the older 'Top 8' spec and only partially migrated to Inner Realm terminology (added Inner Realm in aria-labels + error messages + widget-registry rename migration, but not in the two visible strings on L125 and L215). Fix: two-line change in Top8Editor.jsx. Root cause B (size selector + hidden-note missing): the developer wrote the `changeSize` and `hiddenCount` scaffolding but never wired the UI. Fix: add ~20 lines of JSX inside the header row. Root cause C (progression task rename incomplete): migrate_rename_top8_titles only updates db.progression_tasks and db.widget_registry, but Level Builder's Publish flow snapshots the current task rows into progression_level_versions.snapshot.tasks. Once a level is published, /api/progression/me reads from the snapshot, not from progression_tasks. Fix: extend the migration to iterate progression_level_versions, walk `snapshot.tasks`, and $set name/description/button_label for any task_type_key=='top8_add' entry (or matching legacy strings). Idempotent — run once. Reproduction for A/B: sign in as auditcheckreal → /profile → open Edit Profile. Body text shows 'Top 8 auto-saves' and no size selector. Reproduction for C: sign in as any user on Rising Star level (level 4) → GET /api/progression/me → find task with task_type_key='top8_add' — name is still 'Complete your Top 8'.
